tools.name: search_materials
tools.description: Finds ceramic raw materials (feldspars, clays, frits, fluxes) and, if asked, colorants in Glazecalc's library by name, alias or maker. Use it to find the exact name the other tools take.

tools.name: get_material
tools.description: One material from Glazecalc's library: its oxides, loss on ignition, whether it is discontinued and what replaces it, where it is sold, hazards and the data sheet it comes from.

tools.name: list_my_materials
tools.description: Lists the materials you have saved in your own Glazecalc account (not the shared library), with their oxides.

tools.name: get_shelf
tools.description: The materials you marked as on hand in Glazecalc (the shelf that Match with what I have uses).

tools.description: Lists the firing logs saved in your Glazecalc account, newest first.

tools.name: get_firing
tools.description: One firing log from your account: its columns (time, temperature, cone...) and rows, and its notes.

tools.name: list_notes
tools.description: The notes in your Glazecalc notebook, newest first, optionally only those about one record (a recipe, material or firing log id).

tools.name: get_my_settings
tools.description: Your Glazecalc settings that matter when talking about glazes: region, temperature scale, cones, language, weight unit, whether lead may be suggested, the limit set recipes are checked against, the currency your prices are in (never the prices), and whether changes made by assistants wait for your a

tools.description: Saves a new glaze recipe in your Glazecalc account, from its base materials and amounts (the library's names, or your own materials'), with optional colorants, notes, firing band and food-surface mark. tools.name: update_recipe
tools.description: Changes one of your saved recipes (an id from list_recipes): its title, its base materials and amounts (the unity formula is worked out again), its notes, firing band or food-surface mark. Only what is given changes. The recipe as it was is kept as an earlier version, so the person can undo the chan

tools.name: add_notebook_entry
tools.description: Adds an entry to your Glazecalc notebook (the Notebook page), with an optional title: a test result, an observation, a firing to try. tools.name: add_my_material
tools.description: Saves a material of your own in your Glazecalc account (the Materials page) from its oxide analysis in weight percent, as on a data sheet, with its loss on ignition. Recipes can then use it by name. Needs an access token that can read and change your records.

tools.name: update_my_material
tools.description: Changes one of your own materials (an id from list_my_materials): its name, oxide analysis in weight percent, loss on ignition or notes. Only what is given changes. Recipes already saved keep their own copy of it. The material as it was is kept as an earlier version, so the person can undo the chang

tools.name: add_to_shelf
tools.description: Marks materials as on hand (the shelf that Match with what I have uses), by the library's names or your own materials'. The shelf as it was is kept: undo_shelf_change puts it back. Needs an access token that can read and change your records.

tools.name: remove_from_shelf
tools.description: Takes materials off the shelf of materials on hand, by name. The materials themselves stay. The shelf as it was is kept: undo_shelf_change puts it back. Needs an access token that can read and change your records.

tools.name: undo_shelf_change
tools.description: Puts back the shelf as it was before its last change (by the website, an access token or an assistant). One step back only: a second call finds nothing to undo until the shelf changes again. Needs an access token that can read and change your records.

tools.name: move_to_trash
tools.description: Moves one of your recipes, materials, notebook entries or firing logs to the Trash, as removing it on the website does.
